current_scope: Implementation: H01-H06 validated in KVM. H07 has 65 accepted native packages through Findutils; full Python retry passed. Groff full-suite recovery is running after correcting its build PATH. Remaining base, package manager, ownership/dependency closure and release gates are pending. No Toddy ISO.

milestones.title: Inspect host and select isolated build environment
acceptance: Inventory actual CPU, RAM, storage, virtualization and installed build tools before making changes; then install/configure the necessary host/guest dependencies under ADR-0003 and record what changed.
Choose a disposable VM and record resource budgets, target disk identity, host/guest boundaries and recovery plan.
Run the selected versioned book host-requirement check in the designated environment and record missing prerequisites; H02 performs the final source freeze.

milestones.title: Freeze books, sources and integrity manifest
acceptance: Download versioned LFS/BLFS books and record SHA-256, exact editions and relevant errata.
Create a package/patch manifest with URLs, versions and upstream integrity data; reject mismatches before extraction.
Update config/books.lock.json to verified with actual hashes; document any mirror substitutions.

milestones.title: Prepare target, build user and package ownership
acceptance: Validate target paths and mounts; create the lfs user/environment inside the chosen guest.
Resolve D03 in an ADR and prototype file ownership, install/remove/upgrade and conflict detection before final builds.
Implement target guards, per-package logging and failed/success marker semantics; demonstrate a safe dry run.

milestones.title: Build the cross-toolchain
acceptance: Compile the book cross-toolchain in order, including binutils, compiler, headers and libc.
Validate compiler targets, linker search paths and an executable produced for the target.
Save per-package logs and source/install manifests; no host or temporary path leak remains unexplained.

milestones.title: Build temporary tools
acceptance: Build the frozen temporary-tool set with the correct target compiler and environment.
Verify expected tools, ownership and PATH without using accidental host substitutes.
Record package results; demonstrate restart of one safe interrupted step without marking failure successful.

milestones.title: Enter chroot and create recoverable checkpoint
acceptance: Mount only the intended guest virtual filesystems and enter the target chroot.
Build the additional temporary tools; capture environment and dependency sanity checks.
Create a checkpoint and demonstrate restoration of a controlled reversible change.

milestones.title: Build and test the final base system
acceptance: Compile the final base packages in frozen book order and track installed file ownership.
Run critical libc/compiler/binutils suites and classify expected versus unexplained failures using primary sources.
Compile/run a C program in the final environment and inspect linkage for host or temporary-toolchain dependencies.

milestones.title: Configure identity, services and basic networking
acceptance: Set os-release, hostname defaults, locales, console, users, time and filesystem configuration.
Configure the selected init/services and minimal network path; record BLFS additions if needed.
Use no reusable published password or baked-in account/API secret; provide an explicit test-login strategy.

milestones.title: Build kernel and boot configuration
acceptance: Record the release CPU baseline and build kernel support for target storage, VM devices and filesystems.
Configure bootloader/kernel command line for BIOS and UEFI test targets.
Save configuration and hashes; verify early boot logs and document driver/firmware exclusions.

milestones.title: Assemble the live system
acceptance: Create initramfs, compressed root and writable live overlay without embedding host mounts.
Demonstrate correct root discovery and volatile-write behavior in a guest.
Document persistence limits, rescue access and boot failure diagnostics.

milestones.title: Produce hybrid ISO and artifact manifest
acceptance: Generate a hybrid BIOS/UEFI image from declared inputs and record artifact SHA-256 and size.
Produce component/source/license inventory and image assembly logs.
Keep binaries outside Git and verify the distribution contains no development credentials.

milestones.title: Verify foundation boot matrix and recovery
acceptance: Boot/login in QEMU BIOS, UEFI and virtual USB; retain sanitized serial logs and commands.
Run uname, filesystem/shell checks and compile/execute C in the target.
Exercise controlled failure/checkpoint recovery; record physical hardware as pending unless actually tested.

milestones.title: Deliver and accept foundation gate G1
acceptance: Review all G1 requirements against actual evidence; no unclassified critical failure remains.
Deliver ISO/checksum/manifest references, live-media instructions, known issues and the Phase 2 handoff.
Record the G1 result explicitly; an untested physical boot is not represented as a pass.

milestones.title: Evaluate desktop, harness, licensing and resource budgets
acceptance: Document GNOME feasibility, open-source harness reuse/custom-core comparison and firmware/driver policy.
Establish numeric boot/idle/tool/retrieval budgets and evaluation workloads on identified hardware.
Record ADRs and exact source/license choices without introducing a mandatory proprietary service.

milestones.title: Build the graphical desktop and essential applications
acceptance: Build the selected BLFS graphics/audio/network stack and desktop from pinned recipes.
Validate login, keyboard/mouse, terminal, editor, browser, file manager and networking in a guest.
Prove the desktop remains usable with the agent and inference services stopped.

milestones.title: Integrate provider adapters and local inference
acceptance: Implement provider capability/streaming/tool/cancellation contracts with mocked protocol tests.
Test a real supported local llama.cpp profile and opt-in API integrations without storing keys in Git.
Document context/resource limits and prove local-only mode does not silently call a hosted fallback.

milestones.title: Implement native tools and privileged execution
acceptance: Provide structured file, shell, package and service tools through authenticated local IPC.
Implement the owner-granted full-administration profile, session/standing policy, revocation and audit records.
Test malicious tool/document content, invalid requests and privilege revocation in a disposable guest.

milestones.title: Implement durable agent tasks and configuration reconciliation
acceptance: Implement persisted lifecycle, bounded retries, cancellation and restart-safe side effects.
Separate declarative desired state from one-off changes and detect/report configuration drift.
Demonstrate restore of a deliberately broken configuration and a stop request that prevents new actions.

milestones.title: Provide terminal, desktop and first-run experience
acceptance: Expose task creation, progress, stop and history through CLI/TUI and an accessible desktop entry point.
Implement first-run API/local/deferred setup and protected credential storage.
Validate keyboard use, visible focus, Portuguese/English copy and normal OS use without a configured model.

milestones.title: Implement memory, retrieval and portable backup
acceptance: Implement canonical per-user state with retention, provenance, correction, export and deletion.
Evaluate SQLite/FTS and optional semantic search using measured quality, latency and resource tests.
Verify backup/restore and deletion propagation to derived indexes; secrets never enter embeddings.

milestones.title: Implement proactive health monitoring and automation
acceptance: Persist schedules and deterministic disk/service probes with deduplication and backoff.
Run an owner-defined workflow under its authorized standing policy and prevent overlap/replay.
Verify meaningful-change notifications, quiet unchanged checks, resource budgets and cancellation.

milestones.title: Add text-to-speech and speech-to-text
acceptance: Evaluate separately licensed speech engines/models and test Portuguese and English.
Provide push-to-talk, device selection, visible microphone state and interruption.
Prove a transcript uses the same task/permission policy; measure latency and offline behavior.

milestones.title: Add versioned plugin and MCP interfaces
acceptance: Define plugin manifests, capability schemas, process boundaries, timeouts and update provenance.
Implement a replaceable MCP adapter and one real integration end-to-end.
Test credential separation, removal/revocation and denial of privileges not granted by owner policy.

milestones.title: Integrate approved branding and production asset variants
acceptance: Retain the approved source PNGs and document all derived assets and production resolutions.
Integrate desktop, boot/login and installer branding with readable contrast and checked small-size icons.
Produce reviewed scalable/small-size artwork where needed; do not label raster studies vector or 4K masters.

milestones.title: Build and test the graphical installer
acceptance: Evaluate Calamares or a justified alternative with guided disk plan and user/locale/boot setup.
Install onto a blank virtual disk, remove ISO and reboot with persistent files/settings.
Test cancellation and recovery; document encryption, dual-boot and Secure Boot support honestly.

milestones.title: Verify installed daily-use release and gate G2
acceptance: Run the complete installed-system scenarios, update recovery, provider failure and stop/revoke tests.
Record the physical hardware smoke matrix or explicitly label a release VM-only.
Prepare hashes, source/build/license inventory, known issues and owner first-ISO/visibility review.
